verdict.line: You lose if you let fights drag past her Q recast and R anchor; you win if you pull her in with E before she's near a wall.

brief.thesis: Darius wins this lane by forcing stand-still trades before Camille's kit is complete — her all-in power spikes once Tactical Sweep (W) hits max rank and The Hextech Ultimatum (R) comes online at 6, but until then she has no reliable way to escape your E (Apprehend) pull. Across 2,841 games Darius sits at 50.9% with both the lane and solo-kill edge, so this is a close fight you're favored to win if you dictate when it starts.

theirWindow.when: Hookshot (E) up and she's near a wall
theirWindow.what: She can leap to the wall and knock you up on landing, opening the fight on her terms. Back off the wall-adjacent side of the lane until her E is down.

yourWindow.what: She has no gap-closer or disengage. Land Q (Decimate) to catch her at range, then fire E (Apprehend) to pull her in and stack Hemorrhage before she can reset the trade.

start.why: The 50.9% win rate pick (81.5% pick rate) — the extra sustain and AD win the early stand-still trades this lane is built around.

boots.why: 49% win rate, 75% pick — Camille leans on auto-attacks (Precision Protocol empowered hits, Adaptive Defenses) so flat damage reduction blunts her poke more than the tenacity on Mercury's Treads.

core.why: The active's cooldown reset lets you reinitiate a second Q-E all-in in the same fight, matching the top build path's 62.3% win rate over 318 games.
The move speed stacking closes the gap before she can kite with Precision Protocol's bonus speed.

runes.keystoneWhy: Her Adaptive Defenses shield only triggers off her own autos landing on you — it does nothing to blunt the stacking Conqueror healing you build from repeatedly hitting her during the extended trades this matchup is fought in.

summoners.why: 50.6% win rate over 27% of games — Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage into secured early kills once you land the E pull, rather than letting her play for a slow disengage.

playing.title: Pull before she reaches a wall
playing.detail: Fire E (Apprehend) the moment she walks into its 535 range if her Hookshot (E) is still on cooldown. Once she's pulled in, she has no tool left to disengage the fight.

playing.title: Hit the blade edge of Q, not the handle
playing.detail: Decimate deals more damage to enemies struck by the blade than the handle — center your swing so Camille is on the outer edge, not standing on top of you, to maximize both damage and the heal.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: At levels 3-5 you have Q-W-E online while her kit is still incomplete. Force fights here rather than waiting, since her Hextech Ultimatum (R) and max-rank Tactical Sweep (W) close the gap once she hits 6 and 9.

playing.title: Respect her Q recast timer
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's empowered recast hits much harder if she delays between the two attacks. If she lands the first empowered auto and backs off instead of immediately re-attacking, expect a bigger second hit — don't stand still through it.

playing.title: Finish with true damage, not a guess
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's damage scales with her Hemorrhage stack count, so wait until she's near 5 stacks before committing your R — the true damage ignores any shield from her passive.

playing.title: Reset fights with Youmuu's active
playing.detail: The cooldown refund lets you disengage and immediately threaten a second E-Q combo in the same skirmish, which is what lets Darius's mid-game item spike outpace her own power curve.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning for why each choice works in this matchup is my own read of the kits.
